header.name: Verdant Bot 1.2.8 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • Autonomous Nether + Pathfinder
header.description: 1.2.8 PATHFINDER + FULLY AUTONOMOUS NETHER: new safety-checked A*/bidirectional A* core (core/pathfinder.js, adapted from nox7's Apache-2.0 Pathfinder technique) with closed-set duplicate suppression, BFS-free generator slicing, ignore/passable/jump-over option lists, Y-axis flood, dig/bridge/pillar edges, node budgets with best-effort partial routes and string-pulled smoothing. runtime/pathfinder.js gives the navigator a wide planner for long trips and after dead ends. New escalating anti-stuck ladder (core/anti-stuck.js + runtime/stuck-recovery.js): classifies suffocation/lava/drowning/cage/loop/stall/no-path/unloaded/portal, then replan -> dig/bridge/pillar -> relocate -> retreat -> honest safe pause. Fully autonomous dimension travel (core/portal.js + runtime/portal-travel.js): finds or builds a portal from real obsidian, lights it, walks in, verifies transit, falls back to the portal's own 1:8 coordinate link with a safe-arrival search, remembers the origin frame and can always return. Terrain, navigator and caches follow the bot between dimensions; crossDimension lets it keep working while the owner is elsewhere. Nether explorer gathers quartz/gold/fortress loot within a leash, returns when hurt/hungry/done. New commands: nether, overworld, travel, whereami, path; config pathdig/pathbridge/travel. 161 new offline tests (73 pathfinder/anti-stuck, 88 travel/service incl. a full fake-engine nether round trip). Keeps 1.2.7 SPEEDRUN FIX and the 1.2.6 efficiency work (A* 1200/r24, staggered directors, cached terrain/inventory) plus the 1.2.4 brain layer, 1.2.3 movement and 1.2.2 mining strategy.
